heroHeadline: DtMF World Tour Adds 12 New Latin America Dates — Mexico City, Santiago, Buenos Aires, San José; European Stadium Leg Opens Barcelona in 9 Days; Adidas Flamboyan Drops at All The Right May 15
heroSubtitle: Tracking the rise from SoundCloud uploads in Vega Baja to 100 billion Spotify streams, a historic Super Bowl LX halftime performance, and Grammy Album of the Year. This week Live Nation and Rimas Entertainment confirmed 12 additional shows to the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour — six more Mexico City nights at Estadio GNP Seguros, two more Santiago and Buenos Aires dates, and a second San José show — driven by record Latin American demand for an album now nineteen months into its release cycle. The Adidas Ballerina "Flamboyan" (Vivid Red, named for Puerto Rico's iconic flowering tree) gets its exclusive early drop at All The Right NYC on May 15, with wide release May 30 via Adidas Confirmed. The DtMF World Tour's first-ever European stadium run opens May 22–23 at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (sold out), 9 days away, followed by Lisbon, Madrid, and 11 countries through July 22 in Brussels — Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years. The Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart confirms "DtMF" at 58 consecutive weeks at No. 1.
